value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clause Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) correctly captures the task's requirement that for every moment the ball is moved (blocker_moved), the agent must either be carrying the key (has_door_key) or pick it up at some point later. Since the task does not command any other specific goal (like picking up the box), the rule-only task warning and empty FINAL_STATES are correct.
